items.title: Is “sort by impact” just vibes?
items.summary: You ask an agent for your top five, sorted by impact, and it hands you a confident list. But you never said what impact means, so what did the agent actually sort by? We ran four models through the same lists 1,500 times to find out, and what we found should change how you ask for a ranking.The post Is “sort by impact” just vibes? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
items.creator: Waldek Mastykarz
